summary: The note describes Berowra Waters, a suburb in northern Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. It is about 40 kilometres north of the Sydney central business district, lies in Hornsby Shire and is part of the North Shore region. It sits north-west of Berowra Heights and west of Berowra.
one_line: Berowra Waters is a northern Sydney suburb in Hornsby Shire, about 40 km north of the Sydney CBD.
key_facts: Berowra Waters is a suburb of northern Sydney, in the state of New South Wales, Australia.
Berowra Waters is located 40 kilometres north of the Sydney central business district.
Berowra Waters is in the local government area of Hornsby Shire.
Berowra Waters is part of the North Shore region.
Berowra Waters is north-west of the suburb of Berowra Heights.
Berowra Waters is west of the suburb of Berowra.
